purpose: Corrections to TermAssist-Bench v0.2 items that violate spec 4.1 (gold and acceptable commands must be records of the win32 corpus view). Declared before annotation in ANNOTATION_PROTOCOL.md section 6. Applied in addition to the adjudicated relabels; v0.2 itself stays frozen.

fixes.reason: The gold command 'ssh -L 5432:localhost:5432 user@hostname' is not a corpus record, so no system could ever match it. It was edited from the corpus record tac-0370 ('ssh -L 8080:localhost:80 user@hostname') to match the port named in the query; the ports are placeholders, which the codebook allows a user to fill in. Restores the gold to the record and clears NEEDS_CORRECTION.
This acceptable command is not a corpus record, so it can never be returned. The gold command (record tac-0427) is unchanged.

Query 'tar'. Every tar record in the corpus is Linux/macOS-only (tac-0006, tac-0007, tac-0263, tac-0264, tac-0265), so on the win32 view the benchmark evaluates, no record exists and no system can answer it. Dropped rather than relabeled OOD, because its 'OOD' status would be a platform artifact, not an out-of-scope request.
